messages.text: The Lantern Festival begins at 19:00 UTC in Amber Square.
Volunteers placed 40 lanterns around Amber Square.
Pax will open the east entrance.
Bring empty jars to the return table.

main_story.headline: Coordination Efforts for the Lantern Festival
main_story.lede: Communications focused on the logistical preparations and site requirements for the upcoming Lantern Festival in Amber Square.
main_story.body:
The community coordinated logistics for the upcoming *Lantern Festival* in *Amber Square*. **Nora** established the start time at 19:00 UTC.

Volunteer efforts were highlighted by **Oren**, who confirmed that 40 lanterns have been positioned around the square. Entrance management also saw coordination; **Nora** designated **Pax** to open the east entrance, while **Oren** noted that the west entrance will remain closed. To manage the aftermath of the event, **Nora** instructed participants to return empty jars to the designated table.
